description: Settlement Check — did this on-chain payment actually settle?: Ask the chain, not the platform: given a transaction hash, returns exists, status_name (success|reverted|pending), block, timestamp, from/to and every USDC Transfer leg, plus claim.checks[] verifying each address and amount you assert. Verdicts: settled | reverted | pending | succeeded_no_value_moved | no_such_transaction. No API key, no signup. Method: POST. Input: {"chain":"base|ethereum","tx":"0x<32 bytes>","claim":"optional one-line claim"}
